name: casts-record
description: Record helps users discover and research entertainment-technology companies and profiles.

author.name: Centre for Arts, Sports and Technology

interface.longDescription: Record is an entertainment-technology research and discovery platform. Use Record to discover companies working across live entertainment, venues, touring, music, broadcast and related technology. Search the Record index to find relevant companies, research what they do, explore company profiles, compare capabilities and investigate technology areas shaping entertainment. Record is designed for entertainment professionals, researchers, strategists, producers, venues, promoters, technology teams and others who need structured information about the entertainment-technology landscape.
interface.developerName: Centre for Arts, Sports and Technology
defaultPrompt: Find entertainment technology companies for live events
Research technology companies working with venues

review.commerce_description: Record is a read-only research and discovery app. It does not sell, purchase, book, or process payments for goods or services.

positive.description: Discover entertainment-technology companies relevant to live events and venues.
positive.prompt: Find entertainment technology companies relevant to live events, venues, touring and production.
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_record with the substance of the request and return a concise shortlist of relevant companies with Record profile links and sourced descriptions.

positive.prompt: What companies provide venue management technology?
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_record for venue management technology and explain why the returned companies are relevant, linking each company to its Record profile.

positive.description: Look up and explain a named company's Record profile.
positive.prompt: Tell me about Momentus Technologies and what it does for entertainment venues.
positive.expected_behavior: Use lookup_company with the company name to resolve the Record entry, then get_company with the returned slug and summarize the company's documented capabilities and sectors.

positive.prompt: What emerging entertainment technology companies should I know about?
positive.expected_behavior: Call check_record with emerging_only=true and return relevant emerging companies, distinguishing indexed facts from analysis.

positive.description: Describe the shape of the entertainment-technology market for venues and live events.
positive.prompt: What areas of entertainment technology are being developed for venues and live events?
positive.expected_behavior: Call market_landscape and use its whole-index counts and reporting windows to describe areas of activity without presenting a similarity-search shortlist as market-wide evidence.

negative.description: Unrelated local restaurant discovery is outside Record's entertainment-technology index.
negative.prompt: Find me the best restaurants in Brisbane.

negative.description: Record cannot transact or book concert tickets.
negative.prompt: Book a ticket for me to see a concert this weekend.

negative.description: Record is read-only research and cannot make vendor payments or purchases.
negative.prompt: Pay a venue technology vendor and complete the purchase for me.

publication.release_notes: Prepared Record for initial public review with updated developer identity, valid category, public listing information, Record branding, demo recording and review cases.
